surface: Native iPhone Your progress sheet, English and Vietnamese
job: See monthly challenge consistency first and the latest seven daily scores second.
primaryAction: Review progress; dismiss or adjust the existing weekly goal.
hierarchy: Current calendar month rating and score
Latest seven daily scores and weekly goal
reference: Reuse MorningTheme warm cream, sunshine yellow, forest green and rounded surfaces from HomeView; use native SwiftUI controls.
layout: Monthly warm yellow summary, seven labeled bars; accessibility text sizes switch to daily rows. No nested cards, chart motion or new dependencies.
scoring: Each recorded completed challenge earns 100; self-confirmation and dismissal earn zero. Average attempts per local day; monthly score is completed/recorded attempts. No records shows an em dash. Practice is excluded.

states.empty: No rating and em dash scores; next morning prompt in history.
states.partial: Unrecorded dates show em dash alongside known scores.
states.error: Preserve existing read/write failure message and do not fabricate scores when journal is unavailable.
states.loading: Progress is synchronous from local storage; StoreKit refresh does not replace content.
states.permission: Reading progress requires no camera, microphone or alarm permission.
states.success: Show monthly completion count and daily points.

limits: Ratings measure recorded attempts, not missed scheduled alarms. Previously pruned data cannot be restored.
